pairs.why: Nearly identical, but B's canopy reads slightly smoother and less fabric-grained, closer to the soft-plastic finish of the real fan and umbrella.
Both parasols have the same build, color and soft finish; I can't see a meaningful difference against the real cards.
A shows a visible fabric weave on the canopy while B has a cleaner smooth gradient with a soft highlight, like the real cards.
B's canopy is smoother and less textured than A's, which matches the real cards' clean soft surfaces better.
A has a slight cloth grain on the canopy; B is smoother and closer to the real cards' simple glossy-soft rendering.
A's lace and canopy look fuzzier and more textured, while B is cleaner and closer to the real cards' smooth finish.
B's canopy surface is a bit smoother and more evenly lit, closer to the real items, while A shows more fabric grain.
A carries more visible fabric texture on the canopy; B's smoother surface reads more like the real cards.
